Yes, this now matches how I think about it. **All / Unread / Archived** and **Read / Unread** are clear, and archiving feels like safely putting something away rather than completing or deleting it. Restoring the earlier reading state is exactly right.

The slight dimming of read items is helpful because unread links stand out, while the read items remain easy to recognize. The labelled controls also feel clear and reassuring. I approve this reading and archiving behavior.
